browserAttempts.detail: Chromium exited 134 before exposing DevTools: process_singleton_posix.cc socket() failed: Operation not permitted (EPERM). No gate or signed-in browser flow executed.

The local URL http://127.0.0.1:38745 returned ERR_CONNECTION_REFUSED in the browser. Inspection of the resulting error tab was then rejected by browser URL security policy; control stopped immediately. This is a local environment reachability/policy limitation and does not establish an application outage.
